correctness.rationale: On four vertices all eight parent choices are classified; three cyclic assignments excluded and five listed, with product weights 1,z,z^2,z^2,z^3. This yields Hx=z^2(z+2)/Z, Hy=z^2(z+1)/Z, A=z^3/Z, Z=1+z+2z^2+z^3 exactly. The stated iid law balances Hx and Hy, giving quotient Z/[2z(z+1)(z+2)]. Elementary limit and monotone cubic prove unboundedness and the unique failure interval; exact rational check at z=1/8 returns 593/306. verify.py enumerates without any external dependencies and its actual execution succeeded.

value.rationale: A natural structural extension of the 2026 quadratic ancestor bound is decisively impossible in general directed networks. The unbounded failure at fixed four-vertex size and strong connectivity excludes every finite universal replacement constant, with a computable exact parameter phase boundary; the result identifies why undirected symmetry is substantive rather than merely convenient.
